problem_type: Viewport navigation and keyboard routing violate shared input ownership and approved movement frame
symptom: Ctrl+D also moves the camera; held WASD continues behind input/modal/outside the viewport; looking down + W lowers the camera; arrows move the target instead of orbiting it. Hidden group children and locked IK handles remain pickable; a mode Escape also clears selection.
direct_cause: Separate navigation listener checks only keydown target/hover and uses camera-forward/world-self rotation; hotkey matching ignores the nonnative platform modifier.
class_root: Keyboard ownership must be validated both at dispatch and each navigation frame; navigation axes and orbit pivot must match the approved common contract.
affected_population: POV navigation writing into camera rest/keyframe
Text inputs, modal dialogs, composition and modified shortcuts

external_sources.purpose: Official onClick override replaces camera tween for face/edge/corner during recording

invariants: Blocked input never drives editor actions or camera frames
WASD preserves world height; EQ changes height; arrow rotation preserves target and orbit radius
Unexpected Ctrl/Meta modifiers cannot match unmodified bindings
Picking excludes ancestor-hidden or ancestor-locked objects and their special handles; skinned meshes never reenter proxy picking
Creation mode owns the first Escape before selection or editor exit
At most one creation mode owns pointers and Orbit; entering a mode schedules visible UI state immediately
One multi-entity shortcut or continuous POV gesture produces one undo step
Viewcube cannot jump the camera during motion recording
Portal skeletons and gizmos obey object, ancestor and scene visibility.
generality_proof: The common text/composition/modal guard is consumed by command and camera key listeners. Each frame rechecks navigation ownership and clears stale keys; camera movement is shared by free view and POV.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own text, composition, consumed-event and modal rejection
Own navigation input lifetime and reference-frame math
Apply visibility/lock/mesh eligibility to all picking passes
Yield Escape to active creation mode before shell state changes
Own creation-mode cancellation and Orbit lifetime for all creation tools
Resolve actual renderer visibility and reactive scene object ancestry for picking, labels and portal overlays

same_class_entry_points.evidence: One navigation path feeds free view and POV
All table-driven shortcut bindings use exact modifiers
Normal geometry, registry entries and tagged handles pass the same eligibility boundary

recurrence.reason: Keyboard ownership must be validated both at dispatch and each navigation frame; navigation axes and orbit pivot must match the approved common contract.
same_class_scan: rg isTextTarget / addEventListener keydown across director: ViewCamera, useDirectorHotkeys, DirectorEditor, creation and timeline inspected
Reference navigation behavior compared directly against ViewCamera horizontal and arrow invariants
Inspected picking candidate population from scene.traverse and registry.entries including proxy, IK, bone and waypoint meshes
Inspected portal SkeletonVisual/SkeletonHandles and shared parent visibility with picking and labels; hidden scene/parent/root cannot leak overlays.

prevention.invariant: Blocked input never drives editor actions or camera frames; WASD preserves world height; EQ changes height; arrow rotation preserves target and orbit radius; Unexpected Ctrl/Meta modifiers cannot match unmodified bindings
prevention.failure_mode: Reject input and clear latched movement before any camera mutation.
prevention.strategy: The common text/composition/modal guard is consumed by command and camera key listeners. Each frame rechecks navigation ownership and clears stale keys; camera movement is shared by free view and POV.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove ViewCamera private text-only guard and camera-forward/self-pivot behavior.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: React/three/desktop bridge remain unchanged; the application owns keyboard routing, coordinate contract and asynchronous operation lifetime.

migration: No persisted schema changes. Existing projects use the corrected runtime boundaries upon next open.
residual_risks: Hardware keyboard layouts and native IME behavior require platform integration evidence; deterministic regression tests exercise actual hook ownership with synthetic input.

invariant_owner_layer.why: 不变量由 src/workbench/generationCanvas/nodes/director/scene/ViewCamera.tsx 单点持有（即本合同的 prevention.enforcement_path / shared_boundaries）；上游其它入口只调用它、不各自重判。tests 是该层现有的类级与回归测试，改动这条不变量必先让它们红。
